mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_principal_issue_receipts (tenant_id, request_id, actor_ref, fingerprint) VALUES (#{tenant}, CAST(#{request} AS uuid), #{actor}, #{fingerprint}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, request_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_principal_issue_receipts SET principal_id = #{principal} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenant} AND request_id = CAST(#{request} AS uuid) AND principal_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT actor_ref, fingerprint, principal_id FROM nw_principal_issue_receipts WHERE tenant_id = #{tenant} AND request_id = CAST(#{request} AS uuid)
